method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 13 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: The horse made the state
picks.author: Lhamsuren Munkh-Erdene
picks.why_it_matters: Argues that transport animals, not grain, made the state, and that the grain thesis traces to Lattimore's Cold War politics rather than archaeology.

picks.title: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
picks.author: zaik
picks.why_it_matters: A concrete exploit chain: a leaked extension UUID, an iframe-driven element picker and a newline injected into a filter option give universal XSS in uBlock Origin.

picks.title: The Profligacy Principle
picks.author: Venkatesh Rao
picks.why_it_matters: Inverts Occam's razor into a 'waste entities' principle, extending Alan Kay's 'waste transistors' to generative AI, nature and worlding.

picks.title: A Dead Star Is Flashing Radio Waves Every 8 Minutes
picks.author: Natasha Hurley-Walker
picks.why_it_matters: Shows how pulse-timing delays and a barely wobbling Sun-like star weigh an unseen companion, revealing a white dwarf pulsar that is too light to be a neutron star.

picks.title: 374 | Lindsey Fitzharris on Forensic Pathology, Reconstructive Surgery, and Sherlock Holmes
picks.author: Sean Carroll
picks.why_it_matters: The real surgeon behind Sherlock Holmes's deductive method, plus Harold Gillies and WWI facial reconstruction: well-told history of medicine from an unfamiliar field.
